core.title: Decorative Ornate Lever Mortise Lockset, Omnia 50251

text.description_html:
Omnia 50251 Decorative Ornate Lever Mortise Lockset

Omnia ornate lever design for residential and commercial use. Built to withstand heavy use, Omnia commercial grade, UL listed, fire rated, mortise locks combine precision engineering for security and durability with attractive designs.

Also available for standard pre-drilled doors: Omnia D50251

Each set contains door levers, backplates, mortise latchset, spindle, and all necessary screws and templates. Key functions are supplied with lock cylinder/s and turnpiece as applicable.

Specifications for Omnia 50251 Decorative Mortise Set

  • Backplate Height 17-3/4"
  • Doors Thickness: Optional, 1-3/4" - 2-1/4" Thick Doors (Contact us if doors are thicker)
  • Backset: 2-1/2"or 2-3/4"
  • Solid Brass Decorative Levers and Trim
  • Tough, non rusting materials used throughout.
  • Mortise case is heavy wrought steel with zinc dichromate finish for corrosion resistance.
  • Front: Adjustable armored steel front, with 8" x 1-1/4" solid brass faceplate for all lock bodies, finished to match trim.
  • Deadbolt: Full 1" Throw, Solid Brass with Saw-proof Insert.
  • Lock Cylinder: Standard "C" keyway supplied with two nickel silver keys.
  • Omnia Mortise Lockset Dimensions & Specs (PDF)

When Selecting a Function:

  • Dummy Pair: Stationary both sides of door. Fixed levers, non-functioning. Used as door pulls or to match trim.
  • Passage (Hall / Closet): Latchbolt operates by lever from either side.
  • Privacy (Bathroom / Bedroom): Latchbolt operates by lever from either side. Deadbolt by turnpiece inside and emergency key outside. Turning inside lever will retract both deadbolt and latchbolt at the same time.
  • Single Cylinder Entry: Latchbolt operates by lever from either side except when outside trim is locked by stop-button; then opens by key outside, by lever inside. Deadbolt activated by key outside and by turnpiece inside.
  • Double Cylinder Entry: Latchbolt operates by lever from either side except when outside trim is locked by stop-button; then opens by key outside, by lever inside. Deadbolt activated only by key from either side.
  • Panic Proof Entry: Latchbolt operates by lever from either side except when outside trim is locked by stop-button. Deadbolt activated by key outside and by turnpiece inside. Turning inside lever will retract both deadbolt and latchbolt at the same time.
  • Storeroom: Latchbolt operates by lever inside and by key outside. The outside lever is rigid. Auxiliary latchbolt deadlocks latchbolt.
